name: frame_tool_authority

test_list.description: A Workspace capability may be attenuated to a narrower path scope, but a child cannot widen an Exact, Prefix, or Symbol parent to Workspace; all other ancestor restrictions remain effective.
An active frame issues a sealed local binding that matches its actual token and rejects a different token; the binding exposes only frame identity, root identity, role, and a boolean match result.
A spawned child binding reports its own frame id, preserves the root frame id, and does not match the parent's token.

inputs.name: active_frame
inputs.description: The actual active runtime frame containing its own id, root id, role, and token.

output_description: A sealed local runtime-object witness with private fields, redacted Debug output, frame_id/root_frame_id/role getters, and matches_token(&Token); it is not a signed holder binding or a replacement for Biscuit authorization.
